scope: CPU int32 scalar task captures/results and checked arithmetic, mixed scalar frames, nested supervision and typed executable roots.

semantics.types: Int32 and float32 retain distinct concrete identities through typed IR, continuation slots, packets, frames, cached outcomes and executable results. No implicit conversions.
semantics.layouts: Generated result wrappers contain the existing failure header plus a typed payload. Int32 scalar layout keys/IDs and globals differ from float32 despite equal payload width; ordinary runtime numeric adapter layouts remain unchanged.
semantics.arithmetic: The common planner extracts int32 scalar operations into checked synchronous MLIR numerical steps. Task emission reuses existing scalar lowering rather than duplicating integer arithmetic rules.
semantics.faults: The existing checked invocation records the first fault/source span, stops the task, and settles its groups. A supervised child ArithmeticFault is exposed as TaskError.Fault/FaultKind.Arithmetic; handlers may recover after group settlement.
semantics.root: An uncaught child error reports TaskError.Fault; an arithmetic fault in the coordinating task reports ArithmeticFault. Typed int32 and float32 root entries preserve exact result/error behavior.
semantics.cancellation_and_ownership: Existing bounded scheduler, cancellation, capture copying, immutable tensor ownership and cleanup retained; no scheduler/runtime changes.
semantics.remaining: Int32 tensors, reductions/matmul, Metal modules/kernels, conversions and other source numeric arithmetic types remain separately gated.

coverage: signed endpoints and exact integers beyond float32 precision
mixed scalar captures and result layouts
overflow, division/remainder by zero and signed-minimum division faults
source line/column retained in supervised and coordinating faults
original parent tensor remains usable after failed batch
root allocation failure settles without live owners
invalid worker configurations preserve typed admission errors
full previous scalar runtime/reference and CPU/Metal regression

distributed_execution: Not implemented; separate design-review gate retained in docs/roadmap.md.
performance: Correctness/type integration milestone. Checked scalar numerical calls introduce overhead; no task-speedup claim.
